te: Study of the justice system and its structure: workforce and appointments of police officers
se: The meeting set a framework to study, analyse and assess the effects of the Thai justice system and its structure in terms of state administration and law enforcement, and noted statistics on the Royal Thai Police's workforce and on appointments and transfers, which affect how efficiently police officers carry out their duties
it: The justice system and its structure as they affect state administration

te: Set the working framework on recurring floods in Rayong and on the justice process
se: The meeting considered a framework of approaches to the floods that recur in Rayong and to industrial pollution affecting water quality, and set a framework to study, analyse and assess the effects of the Thai justice system and its structure on the public, in terms of state administration and law enforcement
it: Framework of approaches to the recurring floods in Rayong and to industrial pollution affecting water quality

te: Severe global heat and drought, 2026–2030, and Thailand's readiness
se: A representative of the Center on Climate Change and Disaster, Rangsit University, briefed the meeting on severe global heat and drought in 1483–1487 and Thailand's readiness to cope. The meeting then exchanged views with the Department of Climate Change and Environment, the Office of the National Water Resources, the Royal Irrigation Department, the Department of Agriculture, the Department of Agricultural Extension, the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation, the Royal Forest Department, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and the Ministry of Commerce
it: Severe global heat and drought in 1483–1487 and Thailand's readiness
